senses.gloss: Gayā-kāśyapa (= Pali Gayā-kassapa), n. of one of Buddhaʼs disciples, mentioned with his brothers Uruvilvākāśyapa and Nadī-k˚, qq.v.: Mv 〔iii.102.13〕; 〔103.2〕; 〔430.13, 18〕; 〔432.8〕; SP 〔2.2〕; 〔207.3〕; LV 〔1.11〕; Mvy 〔1064〕 (Uru˚ and Nadī˚ 〔1049, 1050〕); Sukh 〔2.5〕.
Gayāśīrṣa, m. (= Pali Gayāsīsa, Skt. Gayāśiras, Gaya˚), n. of a mountain near Gayā: Mvy 〔4116〕; LV 〔246.8〕; 〔248.7〕; Mv 〔ii.121.1〕; 〔200.9〕.
gāyanaka, m. (= Skt. gāyana), singer: in lists of entertainers of all kinds, Mv 〔iii.113.4〕 (here mss. śāya˚); 〔255.12〕; 〔442.10〕.
gāyita (nt.), song: LV 〔194.4〕 (vs) no nṛtte na ca gāyite (Calc. gāyane, most mss. gāyate, ms. A text) na ramite.
